_note: The little school (C2/F3, the automation tab's school page): classes of spare herd pets. 'sizes' are the first classes' sizes, then each class is 'grow' times the last (rounded to 'round'). A class fills 'desks' desks on screen (a desk per share of the class). When a class is full you ring the bell: it becomes teachers for good (its pets never come back to the herd, but they stay on, so no night-sky stars) and every worker (machines, box tables and errand crews) gets quicker by the class's step, multiplied with every class before. A class's step in % is step.base + step.per_point x the class's average stand points ('points' per rarity; the finish doesn't count). teachers_shown: finished classes shown in the teachers row (newest first). Numbers are placeholders.
